name: com.streethawk.library.push.SHFeedbackActivity
description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. StreetHawk opens this Activity from a push-campaign feedback prompt. It collects a subject and message, sends them to StreetHawk, and reports whether the prompt was accepted or canceled.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to submit feedback through StreetHawk push prompts.
